## Goal
As an engine maintainer I want shared UI lifecycle (destroyed/enabled flags, listener tracking, defaults merging) extracted into a UIComponentBase so HelpButton, SettingsButton, HintBar, Slider, PileView, TokenPileView do not repeat init/cleanup boilerplate.

## What to do
- Create src/ui/UIComponentBase.ts with destroyed/enabled state, protected on() listener tracking, abstract destroyContent(), idempotent destroy().
- Migrate 2-3 representative components (e.g. HelpButton, Slider) to extend/use it.
- Export from src/ui barrel.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] UIComponentBase exists with listener auto-cleanup and covered by unit tests
- [ ] 2+ components migrated with no behaviour change (unit + build pass)
- [ ] No increase in build warnings; docs updated if public API changed

## Goal
As an engine maintainer I want a shared applyDefaults<T>() + OptionDefaults<T> helper so option objects (placeCard, dealCard, dragDrop, overlays) get compile-time safety instead of repetitive options?.field ?? default.

## What to do
- Add applyDefaults() and OptionDefaults type to core-engine (e.g. src/core-engine/config-defaults.ts), export via barrel.
- Apply to 3-4 high-traffic functions (placeCard, dealCard, dragDrop config).
- Convert scattered magic numbers to typed Readonly defaults (as const).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] applyDefaults helper exists with unit tests (undefined handling, partial merge)
- [ ] 3+ call sites migrated, no behaviour change, build passes
- [ ] Missing required fields caught at compile time
